text: Anti-inflammatory drugs should not be used long-term because side effects are significant. Stomach upset/ulcers are common, especially in pigs, which can stop eating from stomach pain — offer palatable, doughy feed and limit use to about 3 days. Steroidal anti-inflammatories (Cortisone, Dexamethasone) can cause abortion if given during pregnancy, with risk rising after about 2.5 months of gestation in sows and 6 months in cows — avoid them during pregnancy. They also weaken the immune system with long-term use, which is especially risky during viral disease, since antibody production (the only real defense against viruses) is suppressed — avoid Cortisone/Dexamethasone during viral illness, and don't give Dexamethasone at the same time as a vaccination, since it blunts the vaccine response.
